title: HKU UAS recruitment poster showing a drone, controller and small wheeled robot
objects_and_counts: Two people are visible in the upper-right photographic panel; both are partially visible and wearing face masks (upper-right region).
One quadcopter-style rotorcraft is visible on a wooden bench in the central photographic panel; the aircraft is pictured whole and is not obscured.
One handheld radio/remote controller is visible on the same bench near the quadcopter (central photographic panel).
One small wheeled robot chassis with exposed electronics and two visible yellow wheels is on the same bench near the controller (central photographic panel).
One white square/rectangular dish or panel antenna (white plate) is placed on the bench next to the quadcopter (central photographic panel).

Multiple graphic elements are present and repeat across the poster: several bullet lists, map-like rendered aerial imagery in the lower-left, and three laptop/screen icons on the right; these are printed on the poster, not objects in the photographed scene.
A large logo with the text 'HKU UAS' and a stylized lion is printed in the upper-left region of the poster.
visible_text: STUDENT INTEREST GROUP FOCUSING ON UNMANNED AERIAL SYSTEM
ALWAYS LOOKING FOR PASSIONATE NEW MEMBERS.
Interested to join the team? Email us at < hkuuas@gmail.com >
spatial_relations: A large 'HKU UAS' logo and heading occupy the upper-left area of the poster.
A rectangular photographic panel showing a quadcopter, a white dish antenna, a remote controller and a small wheeled robot sits across the central horizontal band, slightly left of center.
A smaller photographic panel with two masked people working is placed in the upper-right quadrant and overlaps the patterned background.

Bulleted lists occupy the left-mid area (starting under the central photo) and a second list of bullets appears on the right-middle area; laptop/screen icons are printed to the right of the right-hand list.
A map-like aerial rendering fills the lower-left corner beneath the left-hand bullet list, and patterned chevron/zigzag graphics form the full-page background behind all panels and text.
The email/contact line is centered along the bottom edge of the poster.
colours_and_materials: The poster background uses a repeating chevron/zigzag pattern in teal, purple, green and dark blue tones.
The bench shown in the central photograph is brown wood (wooden slats).
The dish/panel antenna on the bench is white.
The quadcopter components visible are primarily black with exposed electronic parts; the small wheeled robot has visible yellow wheels and transparent/clear housing for electronics.
Photographic panels include natural colours (skin tones, clothing) and a blue sky in the upper-right photo.
uncertainties: Small printed text at the very bottom center is partially legible and may read 'PIKTOCHART' but is too small to be certain from this image.
There may be additional small labels or model names on the drone, controller or robot electronics, but those labels are not legible at the image resolution provided.

Exact counts of people beyond the two partially visible in the top-right photographic panel cannot be determined; the upper-right panel may contain cropped or partially obscured persons outside the frame.

Some text fragments (for example punctuation or line breaks in the bulleted lists) might be subject to interpretation where line-wrapping occurs; the transcribed visible_text entries follow the readable line breaks as seen.
